description: App shell: dark header, layered wrapper divs around a repeated ticket feed, sticky right rail, utility footer.

referenceProfile.thesis: A dense operations tool: a dark shell header frames a single-column ticket feed with a sticky status rail.
signatureMoves: Every ticket repeats the same title-summary-metadata row grammar, making the feed scannable.
The right rail stays sticky so queue health is visible while the feed scrolls.
transferPreserve: Keep the repeated ticket row grammar and the sticky status rail.
transferAvoid: Do not turn the compact utility surfaces into marketing-style hero sections.
